## About
Lane Irrigation is a wholesale and retail supplier of landscape equipment, locally owned and operated in Campbell. We help contractors and homeowners pick the right equipment and work through problems with irrigation systems, drainage, outdoor lighting and water features.
Owners and managers Dawson Bean and Richard run the store with a crew that came up through landscaping, construction, vineyards and nurseries. Troy uses our on-site pond and lighting room to show how things look and work. Michelle, Gregg, Ulices, Nacho and the rest of the team are at the counter to help.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 67 Google reviews. If you'd rather have the job done for you, we can point you to quality South Bay Area landscape contractors.

## Services
- Sprinklers, Controllers & Valves: Sprinkler heads, controllers and valves for new systems and repairs.
- Drip Irrigation: Drip parts and know-how. Ulices picked up his drip experience doing vineyard maintenance at Miramont Estate Vineyards in Lodi.
- Pipes & Fittings: The pipe and fittings that tie your system together.
- Drainage: Equipment and advice for installing and repairing drainage systems.
- Landscape Lighting: See the effects in our lighting room before you buy.
- Pond Materials: Materials for ponds and water features, with our on-site pond to show how installation works.
- Landscape Materials & Tools: Landscape materials and the tools to put them in.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do installation or repairs?
A: We supply the parts and the advice. If you want the job done for you, we can recommend quality South Bay Area landscape contractors.

Q: Do you sell to homeowners or just contractors?
A: Both. Wholesale or retail, we're happy to help.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM from March through mid-November. We're closed Saturdays from mid-November through February, and closed Sundays.

Q: How do I find you?
A: We're on Cristich Lane in Campbell, 4 blocks away from the Highway 17 and Camden Ave intersection. We share a parking lot with Bobs Towing.
